Game Overview

Cute Sheep Skyblock puts players into a two-player experience centered on embark on a whimsical sky-high adventure with two adorable sheep. Jump between floating islands, dodge crafty farmers, and munch on hay for boosts. Teamwork is essential as you outsmart obstacles and reach mystical portals in this delightful test of timing and strategy.
